# TestFlight 0.0.1 (166) schema fixtures

These files contain schema definitions only, with no player data. They pin the
release at commit `9ea2ad492a7da2c05fe5c3510a6dbb8c09a326e1`:

- `scores.sql`: score schema 14, including the release's summary trigger/index,
  duration guards, and completed repair marker.
- `replays.sql`: replay schema 19, including the old `150` Light Assist constraint
  on remote scores and the absence of pending gauge evidence.

Provenance: [successful TestFlight workflow](https://github.com/SNURhythm/AsoBMaShow/actions/runs/40046354059),
October 24, 2026 UTC. Its logs identify version 0.0.1, uploaded build 166 and
this commit. A read-only App Store Connect query on October 30 KST confirmed
166 as the newest uploaded build, processed and not expired.

`replays.sql` is the ordered list of literal SQL constants used by the release's
`createCurrentReplaySchema`, including `ReplayRepositoryLegacyMigration.h`.
`scores.sql` was generated by executing the release's `createScoreTableSql`,
`createCourseScoreTable`, index builders, imported-IR columns, duration guards,
and `ScoreCacheQueries.h::ensureScoreSummarySchema` against an empty database.
The generator used the release's headers, including its ruleset and lamp IDs.
It then exported `sqlite_master` and the completed repair marker.

`TestFlight166Fixture.h` rebuilds a small synthetic test database using these
pinned definitions, copies matching columns, and restores the release triggers.
It does not just lower `user_version` on a current schema. The score test also
recreates the release selector's persisted `ON score_db.scores` trigger through
an attached database connection.

The existing score and replay suites exercise row preservation, authenticated
chart/course results, JSON/fingerprints, pending writes, replay references,
IR outbox payloads, legacy summaries, expected mutable lamp normalization,
mid-migration rollback, retry and idempotent reopening. CI uses only synthetic
records. The optional private profile checks are documented separately in the
branch validation report and are not required by these tests.
